messages:
Marco: Kicking off a Q3 hosted API roadmap thread. We need to pick the top two priorities for Hosted API this quarter: (A) embeddings latency & caching, (B) rerank accuracy + model pairing, (C) chat streaming/resilience. Context: ACME and FinCorp both pushed for embeddings SLA in their contracts. We should decide scope, launch criteria, and a canary plan. Please call out blockers and minimal success metrics.

Leila: From infra/eng POV, caching/prefix-KV + route-level cache gives the largest unit-cost win. Work required: routing changes (policy-aware routing), cache invalidation, and KV-store ops. Rough estimate: 6w with 2 SWE + 1 infra eng. Main risk = cold-start tail p95/p99 spikes.

Anya: For reranker accuracy improvements, we need an eval sweep + A/B harness. Candidate success metrics: MRR delta >= 6% on our rerank eval set; user-facing latency delta < 20ms median. Also need labelled prompt sets from Customer Success for FinCorp. If rerank moves to Dedicated only, that changes customer impact.

Sam: SRE perspective: we can support a cache tier but need explicit SLOs and a rollback window. Suggested canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback triggers: >2x baseline 5xx, p95 spike > 2x. Also want an ops playbook on cache invalidation.

Tom: Product note: talking to 3 pilot customers this week. Embeddings latency is the recurring ask for search relevance. My preference is embeddings cache + routing first, rerank as second. We should show projected cost savings (customer token spend) as part of the launch.

Marco: Quick proposal for launch criteria (minimal):
```
- Embeddings p95 latency <= 200ms on typical small query (<=128 tokens)
- End-to-end cost per 1k embeddings requests reduced >= 20% vs baseline
- Rerank MRR improvement validated on private test set (if shipped)
- Canary infra + automatic rollback configured
- Docs + migration notes for customers
```
Please add edits. Engineering estimates by Tue EOD would be ideal.

Leila: Confirming estimate: 6w for core infra + 2w for ops hardening. Can compress by 1-2w if we accept p95 target of 250ms initially.

Anya: I can own evals. Need labelled queries from CS (Tom — can you push FinCorp/ACME sets?). Also need 2 model variants prepped for AB: baseline + quantized candidate.

Tom: @Anya yes I will get the sets today. Also request that the product brief include a short ROI calc template that sales can use.

Sam: Canary rollout snippet for ops team: 
```
canary_policy:
  - step: 0.01
    duration: 1h
  - step: 0.10
    duration: 4h
  - step: 0.50
    duration: 24h
rollback_triggers:
  - 5xx_rate > 2x
  - p95_latency > 2x
```

deploy-bot: created #canary-hosted-api channel and scheduled canary window for next Wed 14:00 UTC.

Tom: quick vote: embeddings ✅ (highest), rerank ➖ (second), streaming ➖ (defer).

Marco: Thanks all — I'll synthesize into an OKR slice: 
- Objective: Reduce embeddings latency & per-request cost for Hosted API (Q3)
- Key Result 1: embeddings p95 <= 200ms for 90% of customers
- Key Result 2: per-1k-requests cost <= baseline * 0.8 for pilot customers
- Key Result 3: Canary rollout + rollback playbook validated in staging
I'll draft the PRD and share by EOD tomorrow. If no objections, proceed with engineering planning as estimated.

Leila: No objections. Will add dependency list to the spec.

Anya: Sounds good. Will post eval plan + metrics by Monday.

Sam: I'll prepare canary runbook and SLO changes.

Marco: Great — thanks. I'll post the PRD link here when done.
